findings.text: the generation read defaults to 0 when _HELD_RECORD_READS has no entry for the project, so if that index entry is evicted (LRU limit 64) or cleared between a failed pass and its retry, the variant key matches the memoised failed answer at generation 0 and serves it again without re-reading, leaving the duty dropped in that narrow boundary.

held_inspected() aggregates obligations._HELD_RECORD_READS by tree name across every project in the process and the fleet fixture never clears that global, so the final positive assertion can be satisfied by a leftover entry from another test rather than by this run; the sibling test_held_worktree_fallback_resolves_each_row_once.py:228 clears it.
the declared figure path was not used, and the mechanism the fragment describes would read faster as a small state diagram than as prose alone.
